_doc: Lote 3: las 10 piezas de solo datos de Jesus (aun sin entrada en RealMeshNames(); ver docs/ARTE-TRIPO.md).

parts.name: SM_PART_DECK
parts.detail: a large square flat wooden deck platform made of planks with dark iron edge strips and big corner bolts, very thin and perfectly square. Seen from above at a three-quarter angle

parts.name: SM_PART_ROD
parts.detail: a very long thin wooden pole lying horizontally with dark iron caps on both ends and two small iron rings, extremely slender like a broomstick. Side three-quarter view

parts.name: SM_PART_UBLOCK
parts.detail: a heavy ballast counterweight: a wide low dark iron weight block inside a sturdy wooden frame with a big iron lifting ring on top, twice as wide as tall

parts.name: SM_DEV_CART
parts.detail: the body of a small wooden hand cart without wheels: a low open wooden tray box with short plank sides and iron corner brackets, longer than wide and shallow. Three-quarter view from above

parts.name: SM_DEV_RAILSKID
parts.detail: one very long slim metal ski runner lying flat with a curled-up front tip, a wooden strip on top and bolts, extremely long and narrow. Side three-quarter view

parts.name: SM_DEV_ICEBLOCK
parts.detail: a big slippery slab of clear pale blue ice with frosty white edges and a few cracks, square and half as tall as it is wide

parts.name: SM_DEV_SPIKES
parts.detail: a square wooden board standing upright, covered with many sharp dark iron spikes pointing straight out of its front face. Front three-quarter view

parts.name: SM_DEV_LAUNCHER
parts.detail: a launch pad: a square wooden platform resting on four big coiled steel springs over a dark iron base plate, wide and low

parts.name: SM_DEV_WHEEL_WAGON
parts.detail: a classic wooden wagon wheel with twelve thin spokes, a thin dark iron tire rim and a round wooden hub, narrow (width about one sixth of its diameter). Three-quarter view showing the face of the wheel

parts.name: SM_DEV_PROPELLER
parts.detail: a large four-blade wooden propeller with long twisted wooden blades and a central dark iron hub, seen from the front, flat like a cross
